args.title: Args
args.description: Arguments to pass to the method. The structure depends on the service and method being called. For example, authenticate requires [db, login, password], execute_kw requires [db, uid, password, model, method, args, kwargs].

method.title: Method
method.description: The method to call on the service (e.g., 'version', 'authenticate', 'execute', 'execute_kw'). For 'common' service: version, authenticate, login. For 'object' service: execute, execute_kw.

service.title: Service
service.description: The service to call (e.g., 'common', 'object', 'db'). Common services include 'common' for version/authentication and 'object' for model operations.

database.title: Database
database.description: The database name to connect to. If not provided, defaults to 'openerp' for Odoo.com instances or attempts to extract from metadata.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: JSON-RPC request ID used to match responses with requests. Can be any integer.
